youtube_description:
How the task-based part-time job scam works: small payouts first to build trust, then a Telegram 'VIP' group, prepaid tasks, and your money gets 'stuck'.

A job that asks YOU for money is a scam. Victim of cyber fraud in India? Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
